openings.note: Entrance from the common corridor, swing arc visible. Confirmed 2026-09-23 by the flat's owner: it is on THIS corridor wall, at the corner where the wall meets the TV wall. I briefly moved it onto w_top (the TV wall) after misreading 'other corner' and the owner corrected it back -- the corridor wall is right, and this north end of it is the corner they meant. Clear of the sofa, whose north edge stops 7cm short of the opening.

CORRECTED 2026-09-23 by the flat's owner: bedroom 1 is entered from the kitchen side of the flat, not from the living room, and the door sits at the END CORNER of this wall nearest the living room. Was traced on w_mid_left (the living room's south wall) from a swing arc that belongs here instead. Same clear width as traced (138px = 101.5cm). Placed at the north end, world z 275-377, which is the stretch facing the dining area between the kitchen and the living room. A first attempt further south (z 147-249) was wrong twice over: the owner reported it cutting through the kitchen slab, and indeed the run of units along this wall (f_k_cab2 z24-85, f_k_stove/f_k_hood z106-166, f_k_cab1 z182-243) leaves only ~20cm clear inside the kitchen proper -- nowhere near enough for a 101.5cm door.
arc near lobby; hinge side uncertain
bedroom 3 to common balcony (sliding door); extent guessed
bedroom 2 to common balcony (sliding door); extent guessed

bedroom 1; extent guessed. CONFIRMED 2026-09-23 by the flat's owner as the ONLY bedroom window: bedroom 1 is the single room separate from the other two. The windows previously traced for the living room (wn_liv), bedroom 2 (wn_b2) and bedroom 3 (wn_b3) were wrong and have been removed -- those are solid walls. All four were guessed extents on the external walls, never read from a schedule, which is exactly the class of assumption that needed an owner to check it.
